_comment: What to fetch from Freesound, and under what licence.
LICENCE IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS FILE. Freesound is a MIXED library: a great deal of it
is CC-BY-NC, which forbids commercial use and can never enter this game. Every query here
is licence-filtered at the API, and the fetcher refuses anything that comes back outside
the allowed set even if the filter is edited carelessly. CC-BY is allowed and automatically
written into docs/CREDITS-AUDIO.md; CC0 needs no attribution but gets one anyway.
We take the OGG PREVIEW rather than the original. Previews are the same licence, Unity reads
.ogg natively, they are a fraction of the size, and the original often needs OAuth rather than
a token. For ambience and foley at game volume the difference is inaudible.
Slots are what the GAME asks for. Several sounds per slot is deliberate: one rain loop heard
for ten minutes is worse than no rain.
